acceptanceEvidence: src/domains/setup/checklist.ts getSetupChecklist throws unless the caller is an active OWNER (read-level, not a hidden link); src/app/desk/today/page.tsx only asks for it when the role is OWNER and tolerates a failure; SetupCard returns nothing once all six are done. tests/setup-checklist-integration.test.ts (real Postgres) refuses admin, staff, customer, archived owner and unknown user; tests/today-workspace.test.tsx proves ADMIN/STAFF are never asked, the card hides when complete and a failure does not break Today.
SETUP_STEP_ORDER fixes the order; tests/setup-checklist.test.ts asserts it and tests/today-workspace.test.tsx asserts the rendered numbering 1 to 6.

Every step is computed from saved settings, prices, filing accounts and the business address (no stored tick). Done rows say "Done ✓"; others state the one thing missing. Every href is checked against the real route list and settings sections (tests/setup-checklist.test.ts); each transition is proven on real Postgres (setup-checklist-integration.test.ts); the link names read "Finish this, service area" etc. for screen readers.

src/domains/tax/setup-readiness.ts holds the one definition, now used by both the Taxes overview and the Today card. An exhaustive 7x5x4 agreement test and a real-Postgres test against getTaxWorkspaceOverview prove they cannot disagree; a mutation test (ignoring address confirmation) failed as expected.

Payments: recognized Stripe key plus sync secret, reported only as connected/not and test/live. Email: service key, sender address and customer-email switch. Tests inject the environment and assert no key value appears anywhere in the output; the integration test proves the read writes no settings or audit rows.

externalAcceptance: Real use after the daily release: the owner seeing the card on the live Today page. Payments and email steps only turn to Done once the owner adds the Stripe and email keys in hosting settings (GO-LIVE-CHECKLIST). No live Stripe, customer email or spending was used.
